output.summary: The backlog growth is mainly self-inflicted by the close quota, not demand, effort, capacity or measurement. First-contact demand rose only 4%. Split children, duplicates and reopens drove most of the growth. Agents moved to quick-win picking, and complex tickets aged. The quota-exempt pod and Team C's partial rule change are natural contrasts. Staffing and hours were flat, and closes per day rose. The reopen trigger was unchanged. Payroll is a minor contributor. Quota-to-resignation is confounded by the Corvane pay offer and the deferred pay review. Engineering's role is unquantified. Suspend the quota and use quality measures. Classify the aged tickets. Do not tighten the quota or hire yet.
